All fixture texts and PDF files are original fictional content created for ResearchBench and dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0. They contain no real personal data. Regenerate deterministically with `node tests/fixtures/generate-fixtures.mjs`.

The three numbered PDFs are valid text-based, two-page PDF 1.4 documents. `expected.json` contains reference questions, answers and page anchors. `textless.pdf` is a valid empty page; `corrupt.pdf` is intentionally broken. TXT tests Unicode spans; Markdown tests safe source rendering and blocked remote images. `04-hidden-text.pdf` carries visible text plus an invisible (render mode 3) and a white-fill span, to verify extraction-provenance marking in the source viewer. `05-mixed-pages.pdf` has one text page and one graphic-only page, to verify the extraction-coverage notice.

`06-paint-modes.pdf` covers clipping-only and invisible text, fully transparent fill/stroke, visible black outlines with unused white fill, active fill/stroke combinations, and white text on a black background. White paint is intentionally still a heuristic provenance marker, never proof of invisibility. `pdf-provenance.mjs` generates the valid 50,000-alternating-span adversarial PDF at test runtime, avoiding a large committed binary.
